Which of the following statements with regard to recommendations of the 15th Finance Commission of India are correct?

x: To improve the educational outcomes of the States, the 15th Finance Commission has recommended grants of Rs. 4,800 crore (Rs. 1,200 crore each year) from 2022-23 to 2025-26. While giving its recommendations, the 15th Finance Commission stated that Rs. 45,000 crore is to be kept for all the States as a performance-based incentive grant linked to agricultural reforms. Thus, Statement III is correct. Further, the tax and fiscal efforts criterion has been included with a 2.5% weight, so that States showing better tax collection effort may receive an additional benefit.
